task.title: Complete keyboard/touch model control and static fallback
task.input: model-pointer, the poster and initial camera bounds
task.accept: 1) Tab must reach the specific controls, with keyboard rotation/zoom/reset and Escape available; a single finger operates the model, two fingers zoom within bounds, and the page scrolls in the text area; targets must be at least 44px and must not trigger an inquiry (E-101, E-102). 2) Individually test GLB failure, unsupported WebGL, context lost, and poster-only or FoldBox-only display; each must give a static fallback with inquiry and retry available; reset must return to the initial camera with the complete model visible; posters/procedural demonstrations must not count as successful GLB loads (E-103, E-104).
